name: Spongebob Squarepants: Shrink n' Sink Golf
storyline: Plankton has used the Z200-34g Meta-microplasmic Shrinktron 9000 to shrink SpongeBob and Patrick. While SpongeBob and Patrick are playing micro golf, Plankton attempts to sneak into the Krusty Krab kitchen and steal the secret formula.
summary:
Shrink n' Sink Golf was a SpongeBob SquarePants online game. This game was developed for the 3DVIA Player by Sarbakan and released in 2005 on the Nickelodeon website.

The player chooses to control either SpongeBob or Patrick. While playing, the user has 3 different clubs to choose from. Hitting the ball near a jellyfish can cause points to be awarded to the player or the ball could be warped to a new location. It can also cause the player to receive a stroke penalty. The players aim to get the ball in the hole in as few strokes possible to score the most points.
